facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's 2025/26 budget workbook lists a capital project, National Artificial Intelligence Datacenter Deployment, of ETB 50,000,000 under the Artificial Intelligence Institution, and a National Artificial Intelligence Research Laboratory of ETB 152,649,000, among its EFY 2017 capital projects.
The Ministry of Finance's budget workbook lists an Incubation Center Building Project of ETB 135,679,000 as a capital project of the Artificial Intelligence Institution.
